video_goal: Demonstrate the proper setup and execution of a blood pressure measurement using the Omron Platinum BP5450 monitor.
required_subjects_and_props: Omron Platinum BP5450 monitor, Omron D-ring cuff, table, chair, human subject with bare left arm

outline_steps.visual_action: Place the Omron Platinum BP5450 base unit and the unrolled D-ring cuff on a flat table in front of a seated person.
Push the plastic air tube plug firmly into the air jack located on the left side of the Omron monitor.
Slide the bare left arm through the cylindrical opening of the Omron D-ring pre-formed cuff.
Adjust the cuff vertically so the bottom edge rests exactly half an inch above the inside elbow crease.
Pull the fabric end of the cuff outward to tighten the cylinder snugly against the skin of the arm.
Press the velcro strip down flat to secure the cuff, aligning the air tube straight down the inside of the arm.
Rest the left forearm flat on the table with the palm facing up, aligning the cuff horizontally with the chest.
Press the large, circular START/STOP button on the front panel of the Omron Platinum BP5450.
The fabric of the cuff visibly expands and tightens around the bicep as the internal pump inflates it.
The black-and-white digital dual display screen lights up, showing large numbers rapidly counting upward.
A small heart icon flashes on the digital screen while the large numbers slowly count downward.
The fabric of the cuff visibly softens and loosens around the arm as the air rapidly releases.
The final systolic and diastolic blood pressure numbers lock onto the Omron digital display alongside the pulse rate.
Peel back the velcro strap and slide the deflated cuff off the left arm.
